name: Return to Sven
summary: You carry Jitters' finished journal back to Sven Yorgen's camp near Westfall. Its pages may answer the questions that have haunted him since his family's murder.

sections.title: A Coward's Confession
sections.body: When Sven Yorgen's farm was attacked, Jitters fled into the woods, leaving an incomplete diary behind. Afraid of Sven's anger and haunted by what he had seen, Jitters hid deep in Duskwood. When you find him, he willingly gives you his completed journal. He hopes its full account of the attack will spare him from facing Sven in person.

sections.title: Unmasking the Dark Riders
sections.body: Jitters' finished account connects the pieces of Sven's family's murder. The Dark Riders killed them while searching for an artifact, not in a random undead surge or an attack by feral beasts. Sven also remembers seeing the same hooded figures meet secretly with the necromancer Morbent Fel near the Forlorn Rowe. The journal turns Sven's blind sorrow into a targeted hunt for retribution against Morbent Fel.

faq.q: Why is Jitters so terrified of Sven Yorgen?
faq.answer: Jitters fled Sven's farm and fears facing the grieving farmer's anger. He asks you to take his journal to Sven so he can read the account.

faq.q: What is in Jitters' completed journal?
faq.answer: Jitters' completed journal gives his full account of the events at Sven's farm. Sven needs to read it to understand what happened to his family.

faq.q: Who are the Dark Riders mentioned by Sven?
faq.answer: The Dark Riders are mysterious, hooded figures roaming Duskwood. They search for powerful magical relics and leave death and ruin in their wake.

faq.q: How is Morbent Fel connected to the attack on Sven's farm?
faq.answer: Morbent Fel is a powerful necromancer in western Duskwood. Sven's investigation and Jitters' journal reveal his connection to the attack.

faq.q: Where can Sven Yorgen be found?
faq.answer: Sven has left his ruined farmstead and lives at a small encampment in Duskwood's northwestern hills, near the border crossing into Westfall.

faq.q: What happens after giving Sven the journal?
aliases: next quest after return to sven
faq.answer: Sven reads Jitters' account, then asks you to prove your combat abilities in Proving Your Worth.

angles.text: The Yorgen Farmstead's destruction shows Stormwind's failure to protect Duskwood's frontier settlements from the encroaching shadows.
As a paladin, helping Sven uncover the forces behind his family's murder serves your holy duty to protect the innocent and seek justice.
